confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate of July peak-season prices in Sorrento's tourist core. Not checked against live menus, listings, or booking pages. Restaurant anchors are moderately certain. Drink anchors are less certain: cocktail and wine were set from the beer anchor using approximate Italian tourist-area ratios (cocktail about 1.7x beer, wine glass about 0.9x beer), not from direct price knowledge. Accommodation anchors are the least certain because July rates vary widely by property, booking lead time, and week. They are intended to include Italian VAT and the local tourist tax, but that tax varies by property star rating and may not be fully captured. FX observation comes from RBA exchange-rate text returned in search results; the RBA page itself was not opened.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on Sorrento and the wider Amalfi Coast tourist price level in peak summer, with Naples used as a lower-cost reference for everyday restaurant and bar prices. Accommodation anchors reflect the Sorrento centre and seafront areas where visitors typically stay.
